metadata.description: Test data from the canonical zlib regression test suite (example.c)

hello.note: From example.c line 35: static z_const char hello[] = "hello, hello!"; — the repeated 'hello' stresses compression code better than 'hello world'

dictionary.note: From example.c line 40: static const char dictionary[] = "hello"; — used in preset dictionary tests

buffer_sizes.note: From example.c lines 499-500: uLong uncomprLen = 20000; uLong comprLen = 3 * uncomprLen;

test_gzio.description: Port of test_gzio() from example.c lines 90-164

test_deflate.description: Port of test_deflate() from example.c lines 172-202
test_deflate.note: Uses avail_in = avail_out = 1 per iteration to exercise smallest-buffer path. From line 181: deflateInit(&c_stream, Z_DEFAULT_COMPRESSION) and line 188: c_stream.avail_in = c_stream.avail_out = 1

test_inflate.description: Port of test_inflate() from example.c lines 207-241
test_inflate.note: From line 219: d_stream.avail_in = 0 before inflateInit, then line 226: d_stream.avail_in = d_stream.avail_out = 1 in the loop. One-byte input and output buffers per iteration.

test_large_deflate.description: Port of test_large_deflate() from example.c lines 246-293

steps.input: uncomprLen/2 bytes of compr (10000 bytes of compressed data)

test_large_deflate.note: Total uncompressed = uncomprLen + uncomprLen/2 + uncomprLen = 2*uncomprLen + uncomprLen/2 = 2*20000 + 10000 = 50000. Verified at line 327: d_stream.total_out != 2*uncomprLen + uncomprLen/2

test_large_inflate.description: Port of test_large_inflate() from example.c lines 299-333
test_large_inflate.note: Inflates in a loop, discarding output each pass (d_stream.next_out = uncompr each iteration). Checks d_stream.total_out == 2*uncomprLen + uncomprLen/2 = 50000 at line 327.

test_flush_sync.description: Port of test_flush() + test_sync() from example.c lines 338-408

flush_sequence.note: compr[3]++ forces error in first compressed block

sync_recovery.note: Feed just zlib header (2 bytes), then remaining. inflateSync skips past corruption.
sync_recovery.expected_partial_output: hel (followed by recovered data from after sync point)

test_dictionary.description: Port of test_dict_deflate() + test_dict_inflate() from example.c lines 414-491
test_dictionary.dict_id_check: d_stream.adler must equal dictId (Adler-32 of dictionary)
test_dictionary.note: The dictionary Adler-32 is checked at inflate time to verify correct dictionary
